subject: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Ramanathan <asha.r@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask

Hi team —

Greenleaf just confirmed interest in a small isolated-appliance pilot (VPC-attached physical appliance in their co-lo) to validate regulatory controls and end-to-end performance for an internal clinical app. Before we respond I need three things from product/infra/ops:

1) Minimum viable scope we can realistically deliver in a 12-week pilot (what features are in/out).
2) Clear infra assumptions (networking model, KMS, upgrades, data residency).
3) Rough T-shirt estimate and the preferred funding lane (capex for appliance vs. opex for reserved dedicated capacity).

Attached: pilot-scope-v2.pdf (draft), capex-oppex-estimate.xlsx (high-level).

Can you each give a short answer by EOD Thu so I can consolidate a response and an ask to procurement? Greenleaf procurement is timeline-driven — they want a statement of work draft and cost orientation for their legal/ops review this week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask

Thanks Marissa — quick notes from infra: 

- Minimum viable scope (12 weeks): network isolation + patched appliance image, model-serving runtime (quantized open model), secure KV cache clearing, remote telemetry (minimal), and a documented uplift path to our Private offering. No enterprise features like multi-tenant RBAC or custom monitoring integrations in the first pilot; keep it single-tenant customer-owned KMS.

- Networking model: customer provides cross-connect; we expect 2x1Gbps at baseline, prefer 10Gbps if they plan higher concurrency. Appliance will sit in the customer VLAN with firewall rules we provide. Need to clarify whether Greenleaf will allow our support VPN for debugging (preferred) or wants an offline support plane.

- KMS: customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM) with our gateway for short-lived certificates. 

- Upgrades: planned rolling updates via signed images; patch window must be agreed.

Risk/unknowns: on-site on-call for initial 2-week cutover (engineer + SRE), logistics for shipping hardware, and warranty/repair SLA.

I attached a short infra checklist (see pilot-scope-v2.pdf).

—Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Infra Services | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask

Folks — cost and staffing heads-up:

- Staffing: to run a safe pilot we need 1 product eng (0.5 FTE), 1 infra lead (0.5 FTE), 1 SRE oncall rotation (0.2 FTE for 12 weeks) and 1 solutions engineer on the engagement (0.3 FTE). That maps to 2.0 effective FTEs across teams. If Greenleaf wants a support VPN and remote debugging we need an extra 0.2 FTE for 4 weeks.

- Hardware vs Dedicated: rough numbers in the spreadsheet: appliance CAPEX + shipping + 6 months on-site warranty runs about $125k. Alternative: dedicated reserved capacity entry-level (customer-dedicated in our datacenter/partner colo) would be ~ $95k over 6 months but lacks physical isolation and may not meet compliance gating.

- Procurement ask: Greenleaf will likely want the pilot under a short SOW with an explicit rollback/exit and defined acceptance tests. We should pre-authorize a $20k credit to cover shipping/warranty holdbacks to avoid legal pushback during SOW negotiation.

I'll pull a short staffing manifest and cost split for procurement if you want to include it in the SOW.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Asha Ramanathan <asha.r@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procure@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask

Hi Marissa / team —

Appreciate the rapid turnaround. A few clarifications from Greenleaf: 

- Support VPN: not allowed; our security team requires an offline debug model and onsite partner engineer for any live troubleshooting.
- Networking: we can provide 2x1Gbps links initially; 10Gbps is possible but would add rack changes.
- KMS: we will use our on-prem HSM and cannot hand over root keys; short-lived cert gateway is fine.

On procurement: our legal asks that the pilot SOW include a two-week acceptance window post cutover and a defined escrow for data deletion/return. Budget owner has indicated they can stretch to $140k CAPEX for this pilot if necessary.

Next step: will set up procurement + legal slot next Tue to review SOW draft. Can you send a clean SOW + cost summary by Monday EOD PST?

Thanks,
Asha Ramanathan
Program Manager, Platform Integrations | Greenleaf Health
asha.r@greenleafhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Ramanathan <asha.r@greenleafhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated-Appliance-Pilot scope, infra assumptions, and funding ask

Thanks everyone — consolidation below for SOW/cost deck Monday: 

Scope (12 weeks): deploy single-tenant appliance in Greenleaf colo, runtime (quantized model) + prefix/KV cache clearing, remote telemetry push (no support VPN), acceptance testing window (2 weeks). Exclusions: no multi-tenant RBAC, no custom monitoring connectors.

Infra assumptions: customer to provide cross-connect and 2x1Gbps; HSM for KMS integration; no external support VPN — Redwood engineer on-site for cutover and two incident response on-call days the first month.

Staffing & cost ask: estimated 2.0 FTEs across teams; CAPEX path preferred to meet compliance. Total pilot budget requested: $135k (includes $10k contingency / shipping / 6 month warranty). We will pre-authorize a $20k credit hold for logistics if procurement insists.

Deliverables by Monday EOD PST: clean SOW draft, one-slide cost summary, short staffing manifest. Karthik/Irene/Grace — tag any objections by Mon 09:00 PST or I will send to Greenleaf procurement for Tuesday slot.

Marissa
